steps.title: Obtain ethics approval and donor consent
steps.instruction: Secure approval from the appropriate ethics board and obtain written, signed consent from each healthy donor before collecting blood. Perform all work with human blood in a biological safety cabinet following safety guidelines.

steps.title: Isolate PBMCs from whole blood
steps.instruction: Separate peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) using a density‑gradient centrifugation protocol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 50 mL Falcon tubes each containing 15 mL Lymphoprep (or an equivalent density‑gradient medium).
Collect 15–30 mL whole blood from a healthy donor into BD ACD Solution A Vacutainers.
Transfer 15 mL of blood into each pre‑filled Falcon tube.
Add 15 mL sterile 2 % FBS‑PBS to each tube to dilute the blood 1:1.
Slowly overlay the 30 mL diluted blood onto the Lymphoprep layer without disturbing it (tilt the tube and let the blood flow down the wall).
Centrifuge at 20 °C–22 °C for 20 min at 600 × g with no brake.
Carefully remove ~10 mL of the plasma layer and discard.
Collect the buffy coat without disturbing the red‑cell pellet; combine buffy coats from two tubes if needed and transfer to a new 50 mL Falcon tube.
Top up with 2 % FBS‑PBS and centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 min (brake on) to remove residual Lymphoprep.
Discard supernatant and count isolated PBMCs using Trypan Blue.
Proceed immediately to NK‑cell expansion or cryopreserve the PBMCs for later use.

steps.title: Assess HER2 CAR expression by flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Stain transduced and control NK cells for surface markers, HER2‑Fc chimera binding, viability, and fix cells for acquisition.

substeps.instruction: Pool transduced HER2‑CAR NK cells, control‑vector NK cells, and non‑transduced NK cells into a 5 mL polystyrene tube; wash with 2 mL complete RPMI and centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant, count cells with Trypan Blue, and transfer 100,000 cells of each condition to individual wells of a 96‑well U‑bottom plate.
Prepare surface‑stain master mix (per test): 1 µL anti‑CD56 BV421, 1 µL anti‑CD3 APC‑H7, 1 µL anti‑IgG Fc PE, 1 µL anti‑NGFR APC, 40 µL FACS buffer (total 50 µL).

Set up control wells: one well with HER2‑CAR NK cells + HER2‑Fc chimera protein, four wells of non‑transduced NK cells for unstained, viability‑dye, and FMO controls (IgG‑Fc PE and NGFR APC FMOs optional).
Resuspend the remaining cells at 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in complete RPMI supplemented with 100 IU/mL IL‑2; incubate 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until functional assays (use within 1–2 weeks).
Spin the staining plate 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant, wash with 200 µL PBS, spin again, and discard.
Add 100 µL of a 1:1000 dilution of Fixable Viability Stain 510 (in PBS) to each well; incubate 4 °C for 30 min in the dark.
Prepare HER2‑Fc chimera protein mix: add 2.5 µL recombinant ErbB2/HER2 Fc chimera to 25 µL FACS buffer (per test).
Spin, discard supernatant, wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, spin, discard.
Add 25 µL HER2‑Fc chimera dilution to the appropriate wells (skip the extra HER2‑CAR NK control well); incubate 30 min at 20 °C–22 °C in the dark.
Spin, discard, wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, discard.
Add 50 µL surface‑stain master mix to each well; incubate 4 °C for 30 min in the dark.
Spin, discard, wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, discard.
Add 100 µL of 2 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) solution; incubate 4 °C for 30 min in the dark.
Spin, discard, wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, discard.
Resuspend cells in 200 µL FACS buffer. Samples may be stored at 4 °C for up to 5 days (recommended 24–48 h) before acquisition. Prepare single‑color compensation controls using compensation beads.

steps.title: Prepare NK effector cells for assay
steps.instruction: Collect, count, and resuspend NK cells at the concentration required for the highest effector‑to‑target (E:T) ratio.

substeps.instruction: Transfer NK cells to a 15 mL Falcon tube and centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant and count cells with Trypan Blue.
Resuspend NK cells in complete RPMI to the concentration needed for the highest E:T ratio (e.g., 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL to add 100 µL for a 1:1 ratio).

steps.title: Prepare and CFSE‑label SKBR3 target cells
steps.instruction: Harvest, label with CFSE, and resuspend SKBR3 breast‑cancer cells for use as targets in the cytotoxicity assay.

substeps.instruction: Optional (day before assay): split SKBR3 cells 1:2 to ensure high viability on assay day.
Harvest SKBR3 cells by washing with 10 mL warm PBS, then add 5 mL 1× Trypsin‑EDTA (0.05 %).
Neutralize trypsin with 3 × volume complete DMEM, transfer to a 50 mL Falcon tube, and centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard supernatant, wash cells with 20 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min, discard, and count with Trypan Blue (target viability must be >80 %).
Resuspend cells at 10 × 10⁶ cells/mL in PBS (volume sufficient for the assay).
Prepare a 5 µM CFSE working solution:
• Tube A (15 mL): add 990 µL DMSO, then 10 µL 50 mM CFSE stock; vortex.
• Tube B (15 mL): add 2.70 mL PBS; transfer 300 µL from Tube A, vortex.
• Tube C (15 mL): add 9 mL PBS; transfer 1 mL from Tube B, vortex.
Add an equal volume of the CFSE mixture from Tube C to the resuspended target cells (e.g., 1 mL CFSE mix to 1 mL cells for 10 million cells).
Vortex at low‑medium speed, then incubate 37 °C for 15 min protected from light (wrap tube in foil).
Quench unbound CFSE by adding 10 % FBS‑PBS to the tube, incubate 20 °C–22 °C for 10 min in the dark.
Centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min, wash with 20 mL PBS, centrifuge 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Resuspend cells in a small volume of complete RPMI, count, and adjust to 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL in complete RPMI. Cells are now ready for plating.

steps.title: Set up HER2 CAR‑NK cytotoxicity assay
steps.instruction: Plate effector NK cells and CFSE‑labeled SKBR3 targets at defined E:T ratios in a 96‑well plate.

substeps.instruction: Label the 96‑well plate layout with all conditions (e.g., 1:1, 0.5:1, 0.25:1 E:T ratios, tumor‑only control, CFSE‑only control) following the example layout.
Add effector NK cells:
• 1:1 E:T – add 100 µL NK cells.
• 0.5:1 E:T – add 50 µL NK cells + 50 µL complete RPMI.
• 0.25:1 E:T – add 25 µL NK cells + 75 µL complete RPMI.
Add 100 µL complete RPMI to tumor‑only control wells.
Using a multichannel pipette, add 100 µL CFSE‑labeled target cells to every well containing NK cells and to the tumor‑only and CFSE‑only control wells.
Include an extra well with target cells only (CFSE‑only) for voltage adjustment during acquisition.

steps.title: Incubate cytotoxicity assay
steps.instruction: Incubate the plated assay at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ for 5 hours.

steps.title: Stain and fix assay samples for flow
steps.instruction: Harvest, stain with a fixable viability dye, fix, and prepare samples for flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Spin the plate at 300 × g for 5 min and discard supernatant.
Optional: collect ~150 µL cell‑free supernatant from each well, transfer to a new 96‑well plate, and store at –20 °C for cytokine analysis.
Wash wells with 200 µL PBS, spin 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of eBioscience Fixable Viability Dye eFluor 780 in PBS.
Add 100 µL viability dye to each well; incubate 4 °C for 30 min in the dark.
Spin 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, spin 300 × g for 5 min, discard.
Add 100 µL 1 % PFA; incubate 4 °C for 1 hour in the dark.
Spin 300 × g for 5 min, discard supernatant.
Wash with 200 µL FACS buffer, spin 300 × g for 5 min, discard.
Resuspend each well with 200 µL FACS buffer. Samples may be stored at 4 °C for up to 5 days (recommended 24–48 h) before acquisition.

steps.title: Acquire flow cytometry data
steps.instruction: Transfer fixed samples to appropriate tubes and run on a flow cytometer, ensuring HER2‑CAR NK cells show ≥15 % CAR expression before analysis.

description: Note: Within each section of the protocol we have indicated when a reagent/equipment can be substituted with a similar product, otherwise use the provided reagent/equipment.
